categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Scitop Bio-tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: edible probiotic products, animal and plant microecological preparations, and compound food additives. The company focuses on R&D, production, and sales of these products, serving industries such as food manufacturing, healthcare, cosmetics, animal husbandry, and agriculture. Edible probiotics and microecological preparations constitute the majority of the company's revenue, with compound food additives serving as a complementary segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced microbial fermentation technologies, including precise metabolic flow regulation, continuous spray drying, vacuum freeze-drying, covalent cross-linking encapsulation, and deep solid-state fermentation with temperature and oxygen control. It has developed a large proprietary strain library with over 50,000 lactic acid bacteria strains and employs patented technologies for strain screening, cultivation, and preservation. Production facilities incorporate automation and real-time data analysis to ensure product quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic dairy companies, pharmaceutical firms, animal feed producers, agricultural enterprises, and end consumers through retail channels. The edible probiotic products serve food and beverage manufacturers, functional food producers, pet food companies, and healthcare product manufacturers. Microecological preparations target livestock and aquaculture farms as well as agricultural planting sectors. The company also collaborates with leading domestic enterprises such as Mengniu Dairy, Bright Dairy, and New Hope Dairy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with production bases in Beijing, Inner Mongolia, and Jinhua. Its market coverage extends across economically developed regions and major cities in China, including Northeast, North China, East China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. The company also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for trade activities. The domestic market is the main focus, with growing penetration into less developed areas via e-commerce.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Scitop Bio-tech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It develops and produces probiotic strains and microecological products, supplying raw materials and finished products to food manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, and animal feed producers. The company also engages in technology transfer and customized product development, positioning itself as both a producer and a technology service provider within the probiotic and food additive supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to expand its proprietary strain library and develop high-activity, high-stability probiotic products. It focuses on creating a comprehensive probiotic industry chain from strain screening to end products, emphasizing clinical validation and functional research. Key R&D directions include developing probiotic strains tailored to Chinese populations, postbiotic products, and new applications in food, pharmaceuticals, animal husbandry, and agriculture. The company also invests in intelligent production facilities and aims to achieve import substitution of foreign probiotic strains.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of self-produced probiotic raw materials, microecological preparations, and compound food additives. The company also earns income from technology services such as strain development, technology transfer, and customized product development. Sales channels include direct sales to enterprise customers, distribution through dealers for consumer products, and online retail platforms. The company’s revenue is largely product sales-based with supplementary income from R&D collaborations and licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from multinational corporations like DuPont and Chr. Hansen, which dominate the domestic probiotic raw material market. In probiotic consumer products, competitors include brands such as Yakult and Life Space. In microecological preparations, competitors include producers of antibiotics, enzyme preparations, and spore preparations. For compound food additives, international giants like Danisco and Cargill are major competitors. Beijing Scitop Bio-tech positions itself as a leading domestic player with proprietary strains and strong R&D capabilities, aiming to increase market share through technological innovation and import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 302.8 million, a 1.19% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 94.4 million, up 0.94%. The probiotic segment accounted for over 85% of revenue and showed a 20.85% growth. The company’s total assets reached nearly RMB 1.92 billion, reflecting a 5.83% increase year-over-year. R&D investment increased by 6.24% to RMB 36.3 million, representing 12% of revenue, underscoring a growth trajectory driven by innovation and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its extensive proprietary probiotic strain library, scientific clinical validation, and advanced production technologies as key differentiators. Its strains are tailored to the Chinese population’s gut microbiota, offering superior efficacy and safety. The integration of probiotics with postbiotics expands application scenarios, enhancing product stability and functionality. The company’s comprehensive solutions, including customized formulations and technical support, create strong customer loyalty and competitive advantages in the domestic market, supporting import substitution and high-quality industry development.
